title: Job: Where Is Wisdom Found?

questions.question: Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold that they what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:1 (ESV): "Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold that they refine."

questions.question: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted from what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:2 (ESV): "Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted from the ore."

questions.question: Man puts an end to darkness and searches out to the farthest limit the ore in what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:3 (ESV): "Man puts an end to darkness and searches out to the farthest limit the ore in gloom and deep darkness."

questions.question: But where shall wisdom be found? And where is the place of what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:12 (ESV): "But where shall wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?"

questions.question: Man does not know its worth, and it is not found in the land of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:13 (ESV): "Man does not know its worth, and it is not found in the land of the living."

questions.question: The deep says, 'It is not in me,' and the sea says, 'It is not with whom?'
questions.explanation: Job 28:14 (ESV): "The deep says, 'It is not in me,' and the sea says, 'It is not with me.'"

questions.question: It cannot be bought for gold, and silver cannot be weighed as its what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:15 (ESV): "It cannot be bought for gold, and silver cannot be weighed as its price."

questions.question: It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:16 (ESV): "It cannot be valued in the gold of Ophir, in precious onyx or sapphire."

questions.question: Gold and glass cannot equal it, nor can it be exchanged for jewels of what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:17 (ESV): "Gold and glass cannot equal it, nor can it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold."

questions.question: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal; the price of wisdom is above what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:18 (ESV): "No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal; the price of wisdom is above pearls."

questions.question: God understands the way to it, and he knows its what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:23 (ESV): "God understands the way to it, and he knows its place."

questions.question: For he looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:24 (ESV): "For he looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens."

questions.question: When he gave to the wind its weight and apportioned the waters by what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:25 (ESV): "When he gave to the wind its weight and apportioned the waters by measure,"

questions.question: When he made a decree for the rain and a way for the lightning of the what?
questions.explanation: Job 28:26 (ESV): "when he made a decree for the rain and a way for the lightning of the thunder,"

questions.question: And he said to man, 'Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is what?'
questions.explanation: Job 28:28 (ESV): "And he said to man, 'Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.'"

key_verse_text: And he said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’
